name: Build A Ring
author: belgiumwebnetinc

sections.description:
Create your perfect diamond jewelry set with our customizable bundling feature. Choose from a variety of diamond shapes, set your desired carat range, and adjust the price to suit your budget. You can bundle rings, earrings, necklaces, and bracelets based on your personal preferences. Filter diamonds by shape, carat, or price, ensuring you find the perfect pieces for your collection. Whether it’s a complete set for a special occasion or a unique combination of pieces, our Diamond Bundling feature lets you design jewelry that’s as special as you are.

Features

  • Interactive ring customization
  • Shortcode support to embed the ring builder anywhere: [diamond_gallery]
  • Responsive design
  • Easy setup and configuration
  • Lightweight and fast

Support

For support, please contact us at: shubham@belgiumwebnet.com
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Upload the diamond-gallery.zip file
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Add the shortcode [diamond_gallery] to any page
sections.faq:
How do I display the Diamond Gallery?

Use the shortcode [diamond_gallery] anywhere you want the builder to appear.

Can I customize the look of the ring builder?

Yes, you can customize the styles by editing the CSS file located in assets/css/.
